item.title: Lee Jae-yong Visits Samsung RX Robot Division Ahead of CES 2027
item.description:
Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong visited the newly established RX robot division for the first time, inspecting humanoid arm and dexterous hand technologies slated for display at CES 2027. The division aims to consolidate internal R&D resources to accelerate commercialization from factory deployment to home scenarios.

原文标题：李在镕视察三星 RX 机器人部，聚焦 CES 2027 人形机器人研发

Why it matters：虽为高管视察新闻，但揭示了三星在人形机器人领域的组织架构调整及明确的 CES 2027 产品路线图，对关注具身智能产业化的读者具有参考价值。

item.title: Rokid Launches Glasses 2 with Dual-Chip Architecture and Night Vision Algorithm
item.description:
Rokid has officially launched the second-generation smart glasses, Rokid Glasses 2, starting at 3699 CNY. The new device features a dual-chip architecture and an industry-first video super-night algorithm, significantly enhancing low-light capture capabilities. Additionally, it introduces a novel desktop agent AI connector supporting mainstream tools like Hermes and Codex, strengthening its integration within the developer ecosystem.

原文标题：Rokid Glasses 2 发布：双芯架构与视频超夜算法，3699 元起

item.title: Goldman Sachs: Semiconductors Now Drive Asset Pricing More Than Oil
item.description:
Goldman Sachs research reveals that AI trading has become a dominant force in financial markets, with semiconductor performance explaining ~54% of asset divergence, far surpassing oil's 2%. Recent events like Anthropic's IPO filing have boosted global tech sentiment, causing significant volatility in the Korean market due to its heavy weighting in memory chips. While risk appetite is now tightly coupled with big tech performance, strategists note that investor sentiment has not yet reached historical levels typically associated with optimal buying opportunities.

原文标题：高盛报告：半导体对资产定价影响力已超油价

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 算力基础设施（半导体）在宏观金融定价中的核心地位转变，对理解当前 AI 投资逻辑具有重要参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: Agibot Launches Genie Master Framework for Self-Evolving Robots in Real Scenarios
item.description:
Agibot has released the Genie Master embodied agent framework, enabling its Spirit G2 robot to autonomously identify failures, adjust strategies, and accumulate experience in a real convenience store without human intervention. This marks the first validation of Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) outside simulation labs, signaling a shift from controlled environments to real-world business loops.

原文标题：智元发布 Genie Master 框架 机器人实现真实场景自进化

Why it matters：首次跳出仿真环境在真实业务场景验证具身递归自进化，对机器人自主性发展具有里程碑意义。

item.title: TSMC Plans Up to 20% Price Hike for CoWoS Packaging Amid AI Demand Surge
item.description:
TSMC plans a 10-20% price increase for its CoWoS advanced packaging services due to severe capacity constraints driven by surging AI demand. Pressure has expanded from GPUs to CPUs and ASICs, with equipment lead times extending to 6-8 months; monthly capacity is projected to reach 200k wafers by 2027.

item.title: Anthropic Publishes Paper on Claude Proving ETH as OpenAI Announces Same Result
item.description:
Anthropic released a paper on GitHub revealing that an internal research version of Claude independently discovered the core algorithm disproving the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH) using 14 million output tokens without human input. Coincidentally, OpenAI announced on the same day that its model also found a proof for this mathematical problem, marking a breakthrough in AI's capability to tackle frontier theoretical computer science.

原文标题：Anthropic 发布 Claude 独立证明 ETH 论文 OpenAI 同日宣布相同结论

Why it matters：两大巨头同日宣布 AI 解决顶级数学猜想，且 Anthropic 强调无人类干预的自主发现过程，具有极高的行业里程碑意义。

item.title: Deep Dive into Codex Harness Architecture and New Context Compression Memory System
item.description:
This article provides a deep analysis of the open-source Codex CLI's core Harness architecture, focusing on its recently updated Memory and context compression mechanisms. By utilizing a modular design with 118 crates to isolate core logic, the architecture optimizes long-term memory processing for agents while offering technical implementation insights distinct from Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness.

Why it matters：揭示了主流编码智能体底层架构的演进细节，特别是针对上下文窗口限制的内存管理创新，对 Agent 开发者具有高参考价值。

item.title: Doubao's Citation Weight for Douyin Surges to 31.8%
item.description:
A report by Newrank indicates that Doubao's citation weight for Douyin content surged from 10.79% in May to 31.8% in August, signaling video as a primary source for AI retrieval. The data reveals that semantic similarity and keyword coverage between titles and user queries are the key drivers of citation rates, with keyword matching showing stronger correlation.
